escenas.texto: This week in Europe, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over two hundred and sixty-four million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Europe edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Europe. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, from United Kingdom, John Nellis, with “Which Football Will Bounce the Highest?”. Over seven million views. A Short of just fifty-five seconds. It also has one hundred and eighty comments.

Coming in at number nine, from Spain, Te Cuento Blox, with a video posted four days ago. Over seven point four million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and eighty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has four hundred and thirty-four comments.

Number eight, picha Murray, with “My Sister Picked the WRONG CAR KEY!”. Over seven point seven million views. And get this: it's a channel with about twelve thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-one seconds.

Coming in at number seven, from Portugal, mdscae, with “When Passion Breaks Through Doubt”. Over seven point eight million views. A Short of just fifty-nine seconds. It also has over two thousand comments.

At number six, from United Kingdom, Helen Christie, with “Women did WHAT!?”. Over eight point eight million views. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds. It also has five hundred and fifty-two comments.

In position number five, from United Kingdom, Petya English, with a video posted six days ago. Over nine point seven million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over eleven thousand comments.
In position number four, Zack D. Films, with “How The Staircase Paradox Works”. Over nine point seven million views. A Short of just thirty-two seconds. It also has over one thousand comments.
Bronze medal, from Spain, Vladi & Marta, with a video posted six days ago. Over twelve million views. A Short of just eleven seconds. It also has five hundred and twenty-nine comments.

Silver medal, from France, General Mole, with a video posted six days ago. Over twelve million views. And get this: it's a channel with about fourteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over one thousand comments.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, from Austria, Red Bull, with “World's Biggest Human Catapult”. Over twenty-five million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and seventy thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-six seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Next up, number ten, from Belarus, ГЛЕНТ, with a video posted five days ago. Over four thousand comments. A video over twenty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one point five million views.

In position number nine, from Türkiye, TAMER, with a video posted six days ago. Over five thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over seven hundred and fifty-nine thousand views.

Coming in at number eight, from United Kingdom, BULKHEAD, with “WARDOGS Road to Season 03”. Over six thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over nine hundred and twelve thousand views.

In position number seven, BlushCrunch Studio, with “Here In Your Dreams ft. Liam Pearce Dandy's World Official Song”. Over six thousand comments. It also has over nine hundred and thirty-four thousand views.

Number six, from United Kingdom, Game Maker's Toolkit, with “My game was cloned with AI... what do I do?”. Over six thousand comments. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eight hundred and fifty-seven thousand views.
At number five, from Finland, Brawl Stars, with “Melodie at the beach! Brawl Vice Season”. Over six thousand comments. It also has over four point eight million views.

Coming in at number four, from France, Bodycam Game, with “We Made a Zombie Game You Won’t Want to Play”. Over seven thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and ten thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over four point seven million views.

Bronze medal, from Austria, Red Bull, with “World's Biggest Human Catapult”. Over nine thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and seventy thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-six seconds.
Silver medal, from United Kingdom, Petya English, with a video posted six days ago. Over eleven thousand comments. It also has over nine point seven million views.
And finally, number one most commented, from Türkiye, KARM6, with a video posted five days ago. Over nineteen thousand comments. It also has over two point one million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. At number ten, from Portugal, mdscae, with “When Passion Breaks Through Doubt”. Over two hundred and thirteen thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-nine seconds. It also has over seven point eight million views.

Number nine, from United Kingdom, SizedUnderstood, with “Earthquake vs Bullet Train: The Next 60 Seconds”. Over two hundred and twenty-five thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about twelve thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It got there in just two days.

Next up, number eight, Zack D. Films, with “How This Bug Disappears In A Blink”. Over two hundred and seventy-nine thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-nine seconds. It also has over eight point three million views.
Number seven, from Spain, Karin Herrero, with a video posted six days ago. Over two hundred and eighty-four thousand likes. It also has over six point five million views.

Next up, number six, from United Kingdom, Helen Christie, with “Women did WHAT!?”. Over three hundred and thirty thousand likes. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds. It also has over eight point eight million views.

Next up, number five, from Spain, Vladi & Marta, with a video posted two days ago. Over three hundred and sixty-three thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-five seconds. It got there in just two days.

Coming in at number four, from Spain, CuktawTv ES, with a video posted four days ago. Over three hundred and ninety-two thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

Bronze medal, from France, General Mole, with a video posted six days ago. Over four hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about fourteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over twelve million views.
Silver medal, from United Kingdom, Petya English, with a video posted six days ago. Over four hundred and forty-two thousand likes. It also has over nine point seven million views.

And finally, number one most liked, from Austria, Red Bull, with “World's Biggest Human Catapult”. Over six hundred and forty-four thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and seventy thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-six seconds.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: the Americas. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Europe every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
